ideons.name: Glass Skitter
ideons.text: Moves one space west, northwest or southwest, randomly choosing a legal space and swapping any player Construct into its old space. Then attacks for 1 damage of its element, even if blocked from moving. At the left edge, instead strikes for 9 damage and disappears. Newly hatched insects wait until the next enemy turn.

enemies.name: The Apex Predator
enemies.signature: Commands its surviving Ideons on every move, including Purify. Riven Earth summons a Hollow Sentinel; Hollow Hunger a Ward Leech; Brood summons two Glass Skitters. At most six owned Ideons. Rending Fangs destroys the most valuable Construct; World Eater destroys the two most valuable Constructs. Unmake alternates each cycle: H destroys the fullest row, then V the fullest column. Count all cards, including melded cards; ties choose the topmost row or leftmost column. Corruptions are warned one move before application; destruction is telegraphed. Direct damage rises by 3 per full cycle and another 4 below half HP. Cycle-end Purify clears damage statuses when needed. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Sustain and rebuild your formation. Clear the Sentinel to attack its owner, repair dangerous spaces, and Recall valuable cards before destruction. Its elemental attacks require several defenses.

death.flavor: The mountain was only the beginning of its hunger.
death.summary: The Apex Predator killed you with Hollow Hunger.
death.message: The mountain was only the beginning of its hunger. The Apex Predator killed you with Hollow Hunger. Another traveler may find a different way.
